g.text: STANDARD LAYOUT — 4 Independent Systems Stored Contiguously (Non-Interleaved)
To vectorize step i=1, the CPU must load X₀[1], X₁[1], X₂[1], X₃[1].
Because they are spaced by stride N, direct vector load is impossible.
➔ Compiler falls back to scalar execution (vector units 100% idle).
LEGOLAS++ LAYOUT — Interleaved Vector Packets in 1D RAM (Pack Size P=4)
Loop Period: 6s · Fixed Coordinate System (Zero Text Collision) · Legolas++
